question: One RFP for investment manager services, issued by an education foundation, limits proposals to five single-spaced typewritten pages. How many copies must be submitted and by what deadline?
expected_facts: Six copies, no later than 5 PM on July 1, 2016 (Broward Education Foundation).
acceptance: Require six copies, July 1, 2016, 5 p.m.; issuer/addressee optional. No timezone is stated, so do not require one.

prior_reviews.reason: This is a 2023 Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board RFP, not an education foundation RFP. It requires electronic submission by a different deadline and does not support the requested copy count or deadline.
quotes: The Massachusetts Pension Reserves Investment Management Board (“PRIM”) is requesting responses from firms interested in providing Multi-Asset Credit Investment Management Services.
Proposals, including all attachments, must be delivered electronically via e-mail to Chuck LaPosta at rfpresponses@mapension.com, by 3:00p.m. EDT, December 1, 2023 (the "Response Deadline").
